holder_records.name: Fahd bin Abdulaziz Al Saud
holder_records.note: SPA explicitly styles King Fahd 'رئيس مجلس الوزراء' in its Military Service Council report of 3 October 2004 (SA-PM-01). The 1996 and 2005 session-chairing facts remain institution claims only.
holder_records.uncertainty: No Saudi record for 1990-1995, accession or Council formation order of his was read, so from is null; the death announcement of 1 August 2005 states no day and does not name the office, so until is null. Session chairing without independent office identification does not establish a Prime Minister observation. Continuity is not established.

holder_records.name: Abdullah bin Abdulaziz Al Saud
holder_records.note: Royal Order A/194 of 26/6/1426 AH (SPA, 1 August 2005) continues all members of the Council of Ministers 'برئاستنا' (SA-PM-02). He reconstituted the Council under his chairmanship by A/29 (22 March 2007, effective from its date). The 29 December 2012 budget-session chairing is retained as an institution event only.
holder_records.uncertainty: A/194 states no effective day, so from is null and attested_on is the order's day. The 2007 effective day belongs to the reconstituted Council, not to his office. The Royal Court statement of 23 January 2015 gives his day of death styled King, not Prime Minister, so under the death-notice ruling until is null on sa_pm; continuity between observations is not established.

holder_records.name: Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud
holder_records.note: Royal Order A/54 of 3/4/1436 AH (SPA, 23 January 2015) continues all members of the Council of Ministers 'برئاستنا' (SA-PM-03). He reconstituted the Council under his chairmanship by A/68 (29 January 2015) and A/138 (27 December 2018), and SPA styles him 'رئيس مجلس الوزراء' chairing the session of 17 May 2022.
holder_records.uncertainty: No effective day is stated, so from is null. Royal Order A/61 of 27 September 2022 makes the Crown Prince Prime Minister by exception to Article 56 and states no end for the King, so until is null and is never taken from the successor's appointment. After that order the King chairs only sessions he attends (A/61 item Second); those sessions are claims, not observations here.

holder_records.name: Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud
holder_records.note: Made Prime Minister by item First of Royal Order A/61 of 1/3/1444 AH (SPA, 27 September 2022), 'استثناءً من حكم المادة (السادسة والخمسين)' (SA-PM-04). Listed first as Prime Minister in A/62 the same day, styled 'ولي العهد رئيس مجلس الوزراء' chairing on 25 October 2022 and again on 16 June 2026.
holder_records.uncertainty: The order states no effective day, so from is null under Codex's C01-37 rule and attested_on is the order's day; Umm al-Qura's text of 7 October 2022 is a publication, not a start. No end is stated, so until is null; continuity to 7 September 2026 is not established.
